HALON FIRE SUPPRESSION [X] KEY
Discharges pressurized Halon suppressant cloud. Extinguishes wing and engine fires instantly, preventing catastrophic wing separation and controls failure.
ASYMMETRIC WING LOSS DYNAMICS
Losing a wing part shifts weight to the intact side, tilting the airframe slowly. Counter with opposite stick, full opposite rudder, and throttle to recover.

✈️ FLIGHT CONTROLS & AVIONICS MANUAL

HLFS-5 / HLFS-6 High-Fidelity Tactical Aerobatics & Multirole Fighter Flight Deck

✈️ Primary Flight Controls

Pitch (Elevator): W (Nose Down) / S (Nose Up)
Roll (Ailerons): A (Bank Left) / D (Bank Right)
Rudder & Steer: Q (Left) / E (Right)
Throttle Power: . (Power Up) / , (Power Down)
Pitch Trim: [ (Nose Down) / ] (Nose Up)
Takeoff Trim: HUD [T/O] (+2.5% Pitch)
Mouse Virtual Yoke: Click & Drag HUD Stick Crosshair

⚙️ Aircraft Systems & Surfaces

Wing Flaps (0°-30°): F (Cycle UP / T.O / APR / LDG)
Landing Gear: G (Toggle Gear Extension)
Wing Spoilers: Shift (Airbrakes / Spoilers)
Wheel Brakes: B / Space (Ground Brakes)
Halon Fire Extinguisher: X (Extinguish Engine/Wing Fire)
PAPI Glideslope: 2 White / 2 Red on 3.0° Approach
ILS Radio Landing: RWY 36 110.30 • RWY 09 109.50 MHz

⚔️ Tactical Weapons & SMS

Weapons Management: 6 / M (Toggle SMS Panel)
Master Arm Switch: 1 (Toggle SAFE / ARMED)
Cycle Weapon Store: 2 (Gun / Sidewinder / Bombs / Rockets)
Primary Fire Trigger: Space / Enter (Fire Selected)
Emergency Jettison: Weapons Panel Jettison Button
M61A2 Vulcan Gun: 1,500 RDS CCIP Collimated

🕹️ Cameras, Views & Reset

Cycle Camera: C (Cockpit / Chase / Flyby)
Reset View / Center: R (Recenter Cockpit / Orbit)
Cockpit Freelook: Right Click Drag (Pan Cockpit)
Zoom Camera (FOV): Scroll Wheel / Trackpad
HUD Avionics Dock: H (Toggle On-Screen Instruments)
Restart Flight: Backspace (Instant Respawn)
Hangar / Dispatch: Esc (Open Staging Wizard)
